billboards.alt: KL Rush in-game: the KL skyline at golden hour, KL Tower and the Petronas Twin Towers against the hills
billboards.head: Drive between these towers.
billboards.text: Every object in this library was made for KL Rush, an open-world Kuala Lumpur you can drive in your browser, on a computer or a phone.

billboards.alt: KL Rush in-game: a red car driving under the monorail through the afternoon rain
billboards.head: Then take them out in the rain.
billboards.text: Kapcai, cars and buses on left-hand roads, with traffic lights, monorail trains overhead and tropical storms that leave the roads shining.

billboards.alt: KL Rush in-game: the Jalan Alor night market under strings of red lanterns
billboards.head: Eat your way down Jalan Alor.
billboards.text: Mamak tables, hawker stalls and a Food journal of Malaysian dishes, in a city you can explore day and night.
